title: Converse Off-Diagonal Oscillator Factorization
body_html:
Converse Off-Diagonal Oscillator Factorization

In the converse proof, before the full target \(K'\)-datum is fixed, the off-diagonal oscillator module satisfies \[ {}^\boxminus\omega\simeq {}^\boxminus\kappa\otimes S({}^\boxminus b_K^\perp) \] as a module for the available block-diagonal stabilizer and off-diagonal Yu subgroup. Equivalently it is a direct sum of copies of \({}^\boxminus\kappa\). The block-diagonal action factors as \[ {}^\boxplus\omega_{S_K}={}^b\omega_{S_K}\otimes{}^a\omega_{S_K}, \] and the total translated action factors as \[ \omega_{S_K}={}^\boxplus\omega_{S_K}\otimes{}^\boxminus\omega. \]
proof_html: The proof repeats the off-diagonal block isomorphism and block oscillator action factorization with only the source \(K\)-side fixed. The off-diagonal map is injective and symplectic; its image has orthogonal complement \({}^\boxminus b_K^\perp\). The finite oscillator representation restricts to the tensor product of the Heisenberg-Weil representation on the image and the oscillator representation on the complement, giving the stated multiplicity. The same block-diagonal/off-diagonal calculation as supercuspidal_theta.block_oscillator_action_factorization gives the factorization of the translated action.
